message.content:
The "TRC-20 native" text in the navigation bar is misaligned vertically and appears to be overlapping or positioned too close to the "How it works" link.
There is a noticeable vertical spacing imbalance between the top navigation section and the "How it works" heading in the lower half of the page.
The large background numbers (01, 02, 03) in the bottom cards are poorly aligned, appearing to float awkwardly without a clear baseline relative to the card content.
The arrow icons connecting the bottom three steps are not perfectly centered vertically within the gap between the cards.
The "N" icon in the bottom-left corner appears to be an unfinished or stray UI element without clear context or alignment with the rest of the layout.
